title: Decentralized Domain Name System (DNS) Marketplace powered by Cardano and Handshake blockchains

ms.promise:
・A minting contract that allows the registered owner on Handshake to mint second-level domains on Cardano.
・A reference contract enabling holders of second-level domains to configure DNS settings for their domains.
ms.criteria:
・Functional minting contract for second-level domains.
・Reference contract with DNS configuration functionality.
・Alignment with Cardano-DNS standards (https://github.com/blinklabs-io/cardano-dns).
ms.report:
Output 1: A minting contract that allows the registered owner on Handshake to mint second-level domains on Cardano.
Acceptance Criteria 1: Functional minting contract for second-level domains.
Acceptance Criteria 3: Alignment with Cardano-DNS standards (https://github.com/blinklabs-io/cardano-dns); demonstrated by implementing the token-pair minting/ownership model and validating it in Aiken tests.
Evidence 1: Repository links to the minting and reference contracts. https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/onchain/validators/tld_registration/sld_reference.ak
Evidence 2: Test cases showcasing minting https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/onchain/validators/tld_registration/tests/sld_reference.ak#L49-L65
Documentation is available: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/docs/architecture/smart-contract-architecture.md#operational-workflows

Output 2: A reference contract enabling holders of second-level domains to configure DNS settings for their domains.
Acceptance Criteria 2: Reference contract with DNS configuration functionality.
Acceptance Criteria 3: Alignment with Cardano-DNS standards (https://github.com/blinklabs-io/cardano-dns), demonstrated by enforcing DNS-reference datum/workflow expectations for SLD updates and ownership constraints.
Evidence 1: Repository links to the minting and reference contracts. https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/onchain/validators/tld_registration/sld_reference.ak
Evidence 2: Test cases showcasing DNS configuration functionality https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/onchain/validators/tld_registration/tests/sld_reference.ak#L92-L100
Documentation is available: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-contracts/blob/main/docs/architecture/smart-contract-architecture.md#operational-workflows

ms.promise:
・CLI functionality to register a domain with the controller contract.
・CLI functionality to mint a second-level domain on a registered top-level domain.
・CLI functionality to configure DNS settings on a second-level domain.
・User documentation for operating the CLI.
ms.criteria:
・The CLI must successfully register a top-level domain (TLD) with the controller contract, validate inputs, and provide confirmation with transaction details.
・The CLI must enable minting of second-level domains (SLDs) under a registered TLD, ensuring proper validation and ownership checks.
・The CLI must allow the configuration of DNS settings for SLDs, validating inputs, and confirming updates with transaction details.
・A clear and comprehensive user documentation for operating the CLI.
ms.report:
Output 1: CLI functionality to register a domain with the controller contract.
Acceptance Criteria 1: The CLI must successfully register a top-level domain (TLD) with the controller contract, validate inputs, and provide confirmation with transaction details.
Evidence of Milestone Completion 1: DNS CLI support for registering a Handshake TLD with the controller contract is implemented and released as dns-cli v1.0.0. The implementation, command documentation, protocol mapping, release and successful preprod transaction are available here:
https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dns-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.0
